# DeeMusiq

> DeeMusiq is Africa's home-grown music platform, built in South Africa.
> Listeners stream and download African music while artists publish on their
> own accounts, keep ownership of their work, and get paid fairly.
> Tagline: "It's a drop day."

DeeMusiq is a South African music streaming and download app (open source,
BSD-4-Clause) built Africa-first. The pitch in
one paragraph: for too long African artists have been squeezed by piracy sites
that pay nothing and faraway platforms that take the lion's share — DeeMusiq
flips the model so artists keep their masters, set their own prices, and draw
their royalties when they choose. The app is free, runs on Android, Linux,
Windows and macOS, works offline by default, and is light enough for everyday
devices and everyday connections. Current release: v1.1.0.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://deemusiq.co.za/): Product overview, mission, features, artist onboarding, downloads.
- [Privacy Policy](https://deemusiq.co.za/privacy.html): Offline-by-default data handling, POPIA rights.
- [Terms of Service](https://deemusiq.co.za/terms.html): Tokens, acceptable use, South African governing law.
- [Security & Data Breach Notice](https://deemusiq.co.za/security.html): Safeguards (POPIA s.19), breach notification commitments (s.22), liability limits, responsible disclosure.
- [Press Kit](https://deemusiq.co.za/press/): Brand bio, fact sheet, logos and screenshots, press contact.
- [Downloads](https://deemusiq.co.za/downloads/android): App downloads per platform — /downloads/android, /downloads/windows, /downloads/linux, /downloads/macos (served via a download gateway).

## Facts

- Product: DeeMusiq — music streaming & download app
- Version: 1.1.0 (build 47)
- Platforms: Android (APK), Linux (.deb / AppImage), Windows (.exe), macOS (.dmg)
- Licence: app is open source (BSD-4-Clause); website/brand assets proprietary
- Based in: KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa
- Contact: deemusiq@protonmail.com
